scope: Contextual literature review after recipe freeze; no source, data, architecture, optimizer, selection or threshold change.

observed.selection: Paper states10 initializations and selects lowest training error; ours reports five predetermined main seeds without best-seed selection.

interpretation: Historical context only: original-task order sensitivity and established synthetic QA capability. Different versions, architecture, initialization selection and training recipe prevent a direct matched replication or superiority inference.
exposure_limit: Search snippets and article examples are public bibliographic exposure, not additions to the frozen invented-test or model-training inputs. The strict novelty mask is limited to its declared official-TRAIN/fixture ledger and does not claim complete human/model prior-exposure blinding.
